verdict.rationale: A GPU is not a data-collecting service, but NVIDIA markets the RTX 5080 for running AI models locally and "fully private on your RTX-powered PC" (including through local backends such as Ollama and PyTorch). That implies user data need not leave the machine, so it cannot be used for training. This is an indirect, marketing-level claim rather than an explicit no-training guarantee. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or policy that user data is not used for model training, coverage of NVIDIA software that may send data (NVIDIA app, G-Assist), and independent corroboration of the privacy claim.
